reason: Initial fresh-seed validation showed HC3 and dependent Gaussian score maxT do not uniformly remove size distortions; retain all adverse outcomes and evaluate a model-envelope Monte Carlo rank test.
studentizer: HC3_HAC5 with unchanged calendar/correction; same197 fixed designs
mechanisms: Same three predefined mechanisms and fixed market/masks as original Lab03D; no new fitted DGP selected by real-data significance
pvalue: For each case, rank p_m=(1+sum(abs(T_null_calibration_m)>=abs(T_observed)))/(9999+1); envelope p=max_m p_m; Holm197 on envelope p; strictp<.05
calibration_bank_reused: One independent bank per mechanism, shared across test cases and validation replications; retain dependence. Validation Wilson/MCSE conditional on generated bank; finite rank validity unconditional over independent bank and test draw.
intervals: Invert same rank envelope under exact OLS shift invariance; marginal95% critical=max_m sorted(abs(T_m))[9500]; conservative simultaneous Bonferroni197 critical=max_m sorted(abs(T_m))[9997]. No claim that marginal intervals are Holm simultaneous intervals.
theoretical_scope: Rank super-uniformity requires observed null statistic exchangeable with an independent bank under at least one declared mechanism. Max p protects union of these mechanisms; Holm permits arbitrary cross-case dependence. Beta/intercepts/positive asset scale cancel under the fixed-design location-scale DGP. No guarantee outside this finite mechanism class or for unaudited return construction.
validation_effects: All9 static dense/sparse patterns from original protocol; 1000fresh replications each mechanism. No reuse of initial validation outcomes for claimed new-method validation.
failure_policy: Report all outcomes, including conservative power or further size distortion. Do not silently replace original HAC5 family/empirical findings.
